reports.title: Wisconsin OWI Racial Disparities Analysis
reports.short_finding: Black defendants in Wisconsin OWI cases received significantly longer jail sentences than white defendants with equivalent prior records, a disparity that persists after controlling for age, prior convictions, and county fixed effects.

reports.title: Texas SB 3 / ERCOT Analysis
reports.short_finding: SB 3 weatherization mandates increased generator capacity factors by 1.8 percentage points relative to neighboring states, indicating improved cold-weather reliability. This gain accompanied a 1.1 cent/kWh increase in retail prices, with plant-level reliability varying substantially across generators with a high concentration of below average firms, while utility-level pricing shows energy retail companies concentrated around the average price.

reports.title: Texas Medicaid Non-Expansion Analysis
reports.short_finding: Texas's continued non-expansion of Medicaid is associated with persistently lower insurance coverage and higher cost-access barriers among low-income adults compared to matched expansion states, with effects concentrated in the coverage gap population.

reports.title: ERCOT Retail Electricity Market Analysis
reports.short_finding: Residential electricity demand in ERCOT is price-inelastic, with retail competition correlated with price dispersion across REPs; IV estimates confirm a negative demand response to price that survives instrumentation for wholesale cost pass-through.

reports.title: Hurricane Beryl / CenterPoint Consumer-Harm Analysis
reports.short_finding: Hurricane Beryl caused outages disproportionately concentrated in lower-income Harris County zip codes, with median restoration times exceeding five days in the most-affected areas — a pattern inconsistent with purely storm-severity-driven damage.

reports.title: DOJConst / Constellation-Calpine Merger Analysis
reports.short_finding: Proposed consolidation among Texas electricity generation owners would push post-merger HHI above DOJ thresholds in multiple capacity segments, with simulated market share shifts suggesting meaningful harm to wholesale price competition.
